summary.zh: 先知道東西在哪：引擎在前面、電瓶在後面、動力怎麼送到後輪。
summary.en: First learn where things are: engine at the front, battery at the back, how drive reaches the rear wheels.

text.zh: 把車殼切成「透視」，轉一圈看整台車
text.en: Set the body to X-ray and spin the car around

text.zh: 檢視工具 → 只看「輪胎」，再只看「傳動」
text.en: View tools → isolate Wheels, then Driveline

text.zh: 找到電瓶（提示：不在引擎室）
text.en: Find the battery (hint: not in the engine bay)

summary.zh: 引擎、變速箱、傳動、排氣、底盤、煞車、轉向、電系各自負責什麼。
summary.en: What the engine, gearbox, driveline, exhaust, chassis, brakes, steering and electrics each do.

text.zh: 只看「增壓」：找到渦輪、中冷器、增壓管
text.en: Isolate Boost: find the turbo, intercooler and charge pipe

text.zh: 只看「冷卻」：找到電子水泵和節溫器
text.en: Isolate Cooling: find the electric pump and thermostat

text.zh: 沿著傳動軸看到差速器
text.en: Follow the propshaft to the differential

summary.zh: 用動畫看離合器、同步器、扭力變換器、各檔位動力路徑。
summary.en: Watch the clutch, synchroniser, torque converter and per-gear power path animations.

text.zh: 動畫：踩離合器（切到手排）
動畫：扭力變換器鎖定（切到自排）
text.en: Animation: torque converter lock-up (switch to automatic)

text.zh: 動畫：各檔位動力路徑，按 1 檔和 8 檔比較

summary.zh: 照導覽做一次換火星塞、換機油、換來令片，再自由拆。
summary.en: Follow the guides for plugs, oil and pads, then tear down freely.

text.zh: 自由拆裝：試著拆到曲軸（卡住時看提示）
text.en: Free teardown: try to reach the crankshaft (follow the hints when blocked)

summary.zh: 從症狀推原因，再拆到那個零件、換新、裝回。每個情境先問診、再判斷，判斷對了才動手。
summary.en: Reason from symptom to cause, then strip to the part, replace it and rebuild. Each scenario starts with questions and a diagnosis before any spanners come out.

text.zh: 情境：怠速抖動、引擎燈閃（入門）
情境：冷車咔咔聲（大工程：要拆變速箱）
text.en: Scenario: cold-start rattle (big job: gearbox off)

text.zh: 其他情境在下方清單，做完的會打勾
text.en: More scenarios are listed below; finished ones get a tick
